notes.note: 0602 is a 15-leader x 3-line block. Slot order taken from the script's second Pt_Chara_Check run (10,9,8,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1): 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1. Verified by the opening MessWinSet(+0+42) pointing at Rider 1's slot (#0.43) and by wording (#0.35 Philip, #0.37-39 Momotaros). #0.18 = Zero's last line.
Kyubu ni toritsuita (latched onto / boarded the Cube) rendered 'made it onto the Cube'. Subject 'we' (the party) restored throughout.
W block: #0.34 and #0.36 Shotaro, #0.35 Philip reminding him the mission is only starting.

0603 leader order from its second Pt_Chara_Check run (9,10,8,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1): Wing Zero, 00, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1 (note Wing Zero/00 swapped vs 0602). Confirmed by #0.13 (Momotaros wording), #0.33 (Heero space-mine line), #0.45 (Momotaros climax). 'Virgos' plural chosen because the next line comments on their numbers.
Momotaros only knows the name second-hand ('they called').
God Gundam: source says just 'not an enemy'; rendered 'no match for us'. #0.44 (W) likewise 'us' as W is two people; #0.38 Zero has explicit 'my'.
'Next is the right' = enemy reinforcements appearing from the right (cf. #0.53 and story_110 left/behind). Rendered 'Now from the right!!' consistently.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Leader-variant blocks mapped from the event scripts' Pt_Chara_Check order (0602 and 0603 differ: Wing Zero/00 swapped). Uncertain: 0603 #0.1-15 'Virgos' plural; #0.35/#0.44 'no match for us' (no possessor in source). No new names or terms.
